rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice when someone or something is moving at top speed.

example.english: We drove flat out through the tunnel.
example.traditional: 我哋架車全速衝過條隧道。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 gaa3 ce1 cyun4 cuk1 cung1 gwo3 tiu4 seoi6 dou6

rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice when someone says something bluntly or without holding back.

example.english: Tell me flat out; there’s no need to beat around the bush.
example.traditional: 你直接同我講，唔使兜圈子。
example.jyutping: nei5 zik6 zip3 tung4 ngo5 gong2 m4 sai2 dau1 hyun1 zi2
